$comment: P69 (lane `cs`, D-C-A-COMPOUND-LITERAL-IS-ITS-INITIALIZERS-VALUE-NOT-AN-OBJECT): a compound literal is an unnamed OBJECT (C 6.5.2.5p4). Before the fix DSS lowered it as its initializer's VALUE: `&(int){ x }` was `&x` (a write through it changed `x` — exit 7 in the phase-1 probe), `(char[]){ "ab" }` WAS the read-only string literal (a write crashed, 0xC0000005 / SIGSEGV), two literals were one object, and a block-scope scalar literal's address was refused. MEASURED 2026-09-30 through `dssharness run probe-reference-cc`, this file: gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 at -std=c17 -pedantic-errors and -std=c2x (run 20260930-220605-dd4cc23e), mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 both modes (20260930-220731-5fcd1763) and MSVC 19.51 /std:clatest (20260930-220703-912ce76a) all exit 42. Every operand comes from argc. The release arm is REPORT-ONLY: its value is that the optimized pipeline keeps each literal its own object (the aliasing, recursion and re-initialization checks are exactly what an over-eager forwarding would break).
